properties.state: {"description":"An opt-in parameter on search_design. The design's own hits come back exactly as without it. `tracked_designs` then lists every declared design dependency that names a design: its id and name, how it was reached (export or address), a state (`searched`, `not_watched`, `missing`, `unreadable`, `refused`), its hits when searched, and a sentence when not. An export is loaded into an in-memory design and searched with the same full-text engine, so scores mean the same thing in each design. An address is asked with the MCP handshake and a search_design call, carrying the key `reflow2 setup` stored for that server, and never on a server that does not reach out (a registry of other people's designs), which reports `refused` in upstream_status's own words. Bounded by upstream's read cap, and the cap is reported.
